description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
Saturday June 14 is a National Day of Defiance
Cadet Bone Spur is spending millions on a military parade in D.C. This is the first time in US History that a President has made a public spectacle to celebrate his own birthday. You know who does that? Kings.
Adding insult to injury, this comes on the heels of massive cuts in services to working class and working poor citizens - and the largest cut in taxes for the rich, ever. Join us in sending the message loud and clear: We. Have. No. King.

Rally, March and Sign-Waving:
This event will begin with a short rally at the SE corner of Aurora Ave N and N 185th (near the closed Bartell Drug Store). Following that, those who wish to march with their signs will be led by Everyday Activists proudly bearing a No Kings banner. Those who prefer to sit or stand with their signs (and not march) will have plenty of space to do that along both sides of Aurora Ave N. Flat sidewalks and accessible street crossings make this a  good site for people with mobility challenges.

Transportation, Parking and Bathrooms
We encourage the use of public transit and carpooling. Metro buses stop at the south end of the park (N 175th St) and the north end (N 185th St), and buses run north and south along Aurora Ave N. 
Some parking is available along side streets between N 175th and N 185th. PLEASE do not park at Shoreline City Hall: we have paid only to use "Sculpture Park". Another group has rented the outdoor space at City Hall itself. They have use of the parking there: we do not.
There are no public bathrooms, but there are bathrooms at many of the businesses adjacent to the park (Starbucks, Orange Julius, etc). Be prepared to make a small purchase in order to use the facilities.

Security: Everyday Activists volunteers will be on hand to answer questions, provide assistance, and administer basic first aid. Look for the folks in the tasteful yellow safety vests.

Join us on No Kings day, and let's show the world what peaceful activism looks like!

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*
accessibility_notes:
NEW START POINT: Rally begins at 1:00 at SOUTH end of park (just north of Walgreen's), across from Shoreline City Hall*. Followed by march (or standing with your sign) on both sides of Aurora. Pastor Kate at Ronald United Methodist Church (west side of Aurora) has offered use of bathrooms! Broad, flat sidewalks; no hills along the 8-block stretch; some benches. Feel free to bring a chair.
*Not at NE 185th & Aurora, as previously stated.

description:
Please join us for an organizing zoom call ahead of our third town hall leg in Eastern Idaho. On June 17th, we’ll be meeting at 5:30pm to discuss the logistics of pulling off a successful round of town halls to help inform the public of the dangers of vouchers and the need for people to get involved in this important fight.

During the 2025 legislative session, Idaho lawmakers passed House Bill 93 and enacted a $50 million school-voucher program. For the first time in state history, Idaho tax dollars will be used to subsidize the cost of tuition for private-school families. 

The special-interest groups promoting vouchers have made clear that the $50 million program is only the beginning. During next year’s legislative session, they intend to remove the $50-million cap and expand the program to all private-school families, including the wealthy, at an estimated cost of $339 million per year.
 
Such a massive expansion of vouchers would bankrupt Idaho and drain millions from public schools. For the benefit of a small number of private-school families, it would defund the public education system that serves 94% of Idaho’s kids. 

It may be inevitable that the legislature tries to expand House Bill 93, but it is not inevitable that they will succeed. To stop this attack on public schools, we need to get organized. Please sign up if you can make it and we hope to see you soon!
